subject: Patch closure plan and evidence index for GreenBank SIG request
body:
From: Anita Shah <anita.shah@greenbank.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: GreenBank Security <security@greenbank.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jun 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Request: consolidated remediation evidence + target dates for SIG

Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for the SOC2/SIG intake call yesterday. As a follow-up, our audit team has asked for the consolidated record showing:
- the most recent authenticated vulnerability scan export for the production fleet (host and container results)
- mapping of each open CVE to a remediation owner, target closure date, and current status
- any compensating controls for exceptions and their justification

Can you provide an evidence package and a short attestation from Redwood that GreenBank-facing CVEs will be closed per the dates below, or call out any exceptions? Our target for our SIG submission is 2028-07-05 (internal deadline 2028-07-02).

If possible, a single spreadsheet and a short PDF attestation would be ideal.

Thanks,
Anita
Anita Shah
Security Manager, GreenBank
security@greenbank.com

---

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Anita Shah <anita.shah@greenbank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Jun 2028 10:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: consolidated remediation evidence + target dates for SIG

Hi Anita —

Thanks for the clear ask. We can deliver a single evidence bundle and an attestation PDF. Internal plan:
- Ben will generate the authenticated scan export and the host/container breakdown.
- I will own mapping CVEs to owners and the attestation language.
- Marissa will review and sign the attestation for SIG delivery.

We expect to deliver the first cut on 2028-06-25 and a final attestation package by 2028-06-29 to give you time before your internal deadline.

Deliverables:
1) spreadsheet: CVE | affected asset | owner | current status | target close date | mitigation/compensating control
2) raw scan export (authenticated)
3) short attestation PDF describing cadence, SLA commitments for GreenBank-facing CVEs

Is there any specific template GreenBank prefers for the spreadsheet? If not, we'll use our standard index.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Security & Compliance Program Lead
Redwood Inference

---

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 25 Jun 2028 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: scan exports + initial CVE mapping (internal)

Tessa / Marissa —

Attached: initial exports from the authenticated scanner (Nessus-like export) and an export of our container image scan results. I pulled records scoped to the GreenBank tenancy tags. Notes:
- Total findings: 182 (severity breakdown: Critical 12, High 47, Medium 83, Low 40)
- I assigned provisional owners for each finding based on last-touch in our ticketing system; owners shown in the attached sheet.
- For 9 Criticals, we've scheduled immediate hotfix windows (detection -> patch -> verification) between 2028-06-26 and 2028-06-30.

Attachments: scan-export-20280620.json (stub), remediation-playbook-202806.pdf (stub)

I'll push a cleaned spreadsheet (GB_PATCH_INDEX_20280629.xlsx) with owner/resolution columns by EOD 2028-06-26.

- Ben
Senior Security Engineer
Redwood Inference

---

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Anita Shah <anita.shah@greenbank.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Jun 2028 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood: evidence package and attestation (GreenBank)

Hi Anita —

Please find attached our evidence bundle for GreenBank's SIG submission. Summary:
- GB_PATCH_INDEX_20280629.xlsx — consolidated CVE index (owner, SLA category, target close date, verification notes)
- scan-export-20280620.json — authenticated scanner export (scoped to GB tags)
- remediation-playbook-202806.pdf — internal remediation playbook and verification checklist
- Attestation_GB_20280629.pdf — short attestation signed by Redwood Security (signature block on page 1)

Key commitments in the attestation:
- We commit to our standard SLA tiers: Critical = 7 days, High = 30 days, Medium = 90 days (exceptions documented).
- For GreenBank-scoped Criticals discovered before 2028-06-25, expected closure windows are listed in the spreadsheet. Nine Criticals are scheduled for closure between 2028-06-26 and 2028-06-30.
- We will provide verification evidence (scan delta + remediation ticket ID) within 48 hours of the patch window completion.

Attachments (stubs) included. If you prefer the attestation signed by our VP Security instead of the Security Program Lead, we can arrange that; it will add 24–48 hours.

Best regards,
Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Security
Redwood Inference

Attachments: GB_PATCH_INDEX_20280629.xlsx (workbook stub), scan-export-20280620.json (JSON stub), remediation-playbook-202806.pdf (PDF stub), Attestation_GB_20280629.pdf (PDF stub)

---

From: Anita Shah <anita.shah@greenbank.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 29 Jun 2028 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood: evidence package and attestation (GreenBank)

Marissa —

Received, thank you. The deliverables look good at a high level. A couple of small asks before we close the SIG item:
1) For the nine Criticals with scheduled patch windows, can you add the remediation-ticket numbers (our tracker needs a ticket per CVE)?
2) On the attestation PDF, please include the exact statement: "Redwood Inference attests that GreenBank-scoped Critical CVEs will be remediated within 7 calendar days of detection except where a documented exception is provided."

If you can update the spreadsheet with ticket IDs and append the sentence above to the signed attestation, we can accept this into the SIG packet.

Thanks,
Anita

---

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Anita Shah <anita.shah@greenbank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 29 Jun 2028 11:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood: evidence package and attestation (GreenBank)

Thanks Anita — good catches.

Ben: can you confirm ticket IDs and paste them into the GB_PATCH_INDEX_20280629.xlsx (Criticals tab) and share an updated workbook by 2028-06-29 17:00 PT?
Marissa: can you append the exact attestation sentence Anita requested and re-run the signature (VP or Program Lead — your call) so we can deliver a signed PDF by EOD?

If we can get those two items today, Anita, we'll send you a final package with the requested language and ticket references.

Tessa Morgan
Security & Compliance Program Lead
Redwood Inference
